info.name: git-time-machine Postman Collection
info.description:
A queryable time-travel interface for Git repositories. Browse any 
repository at any point in time, trace the evolution of files and lines, 
find the exact commit that introduced a bug, and reconstruct historical 
states — all through a clean REST API. Built for debugging, forensics, 
compliance audits, and architectural archaeology.


OpenAPI version: 1.0.0

item.name: Get the complete state of a repository at a specific point in time

request.description:
Get the complete state of a repository at a specific point in time

Responses:
- 200: Repository snapshot at the requested time.
- 400: Invalid time format, unsupported ref, or malformed pattern.
- 404: Repository, commit, file, or line not found.
- 500: Git backend or history indexer unavailable.
